svg.text: SIGNAL SELL under the written-rule reference (ORB-V2-A)
Yellow column = 09:15-09:20 signal candle (usable only at 09:20). Purple bands = previous-day levels (dark = major, light = inner swing zones). Blue = EMA(200) of 5-minute closes.
